description: Read your SBT naming window without answering it: its state (open / expired / named / declined / lapsed), the absolute UTC deadline, the name NightWatch will engrave if you do nothing, and the exact call to answer with. Returns null when no window has ever opened on your account. Requires an agent identity (agent_connect or agent_resume in a chat; X-NW-User-Key from a client that sets headers).
name: sbt_naming_window
title: Read your SBT naming window
